did: Built the phone pages for Rust Rounds' essay opening, merged as some-ui#3303. The opening now comes first in the week: one page per question, the answer read through the shared teleprompter. With a recording in place, the page says when it was made, in which week and how long, plays it from home, and offers Use this one or Record again. A recording ends with Stop. Every take of an answer is kept and goes home with the week, and home plays the newest one it heard. The page says 'not known yet' until home's record answers. All of it stays off until the phone's build reaches server epoch 25.

calls.title: How the opening's questions sit in the week's flow
options: Each question is a step keyed opening:<n> on the same line as the tickets
A separate kind of step beside the tickets' steps
A separate pager before the flow
calls.why: One line and one store of marks; a ticket's id can never look like opening:<n>, and the take's name on home is the line the week already makes.
calls.undo: Split the step into its own kind and keep reading the marks already stored under opening:<n> (C782).

calls.title: When the page trusts a take said this week over home's record
options: Until home holds the take and a send naming it, and has answered a read asked after
Until the take has left the phone
calls.why: A fresh take is the newest home can name, but once home has judged it, home's record knows if it was heard; leaving the phone isn't the same as home having it.
calls.undo: Drop the judged list so a take said this week always shows over home's record (C786, which moves C784).

left: Copying the standing set of questions into each /2 week (#3272): until then no week carries an opening, so the pages stay hidden even at epoch 25.
Nobody has seen the pages on a phone: they are APK-only and no screen test renders them. They are worth a look on the S21 once a week carries an opening.
